upcoming_earnings.name: Broadcom Inc.
upcoming_earnings.thesis: Second-largest AI chip company by revenue. Designs custom XPU accelerators for Google (TPU) and Meta (MTIA) — both committed to $1B+ AVGO roadmaps through 2027. VMware integration completing, op margin should expand from 45% to 55%+. Networking silicon (Tomahawk switches) is a winner-take-most market for AI cluster fabric. 29.5% revenue growth, 23x forward PE.
